-- Exercises typed sequence operations and function-valued transformations.
function double(value of type integer) of type integer { give value times 2. }
function positive(value of type integer) of type boolean { give value greater than 0. }

after { sequence.release[integer](mapped) catch nothing. sequence.release[integer](filtered) catch nothing. }
